messages:
maria_cs: FYI FinraCorp just flagged their SIG/CAIQ deliverable — due Friday — they need KMS/HSM attestation and a proof-of-rotation timeline. They also reported API 401s + slow export when pulling audit logs. Escalating.

Tom_Finra: @maria_cs sorry to ping late — our security reviewer hit failures on the bespoke questionnaire. We saw intermittent 401s when calling /v1/sig/export and one export took >20s (timed out). Trace ID: trace-0ac1, request id: req-9f2. Can you confirm keystore rotation history and provide an audit log sample?

maria_cs: Thanks. @tom_finra can you paste the tiniest repro (curl) and the local timestamps? We need to attach precise evidence to the CAIQ.

Tom_Finra: repro:```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXXX" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/sig/export?customer_id=finra-123
```
Failed at 2026-03-14T18:02:12Z with HTTP/1.1 401. Then retried, got 200 but took 22.3s, payload ~4MB.

priya_sre: @maria_cs @jamal_security thanks — can you share the server-side trace ids? If we have trace-0ac1 we can map to node and pod. I'll check routing, rate-limiter, and KMS RPC timings.

jamal_security: Also need key metadata: last rotation time, KMS key version, HSM attestation statement (if available), and the customer-facing statement for rotation practices. If rotation was manual around that window, include who rotated and the change request ID.

kevin_support: I'll ask Finra to grant a one-day extension to the questionnaire and ask them to confirm the exact files they need (attestation PDF vs exported audit CSV). Proposal: provide (1) redacted audit log slice covering the failure window, (2) KMS key metadata JSON, (3) HSM attestation doc or CA-signed statement.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-318-KMS-EXPORT-401 — triage channel eng-sre + security notified.

priya_sre: Quick triage notes: checked traces for trace-0ac1 — routed to node inference-03 in us-west-2. Observed a KMS RPC latency spike ~2026-03-14T18:02:11Z (200ms -> 1.8s) and an exporter worker GC pause ~15s on the same pod. Likely compounding cause for the long export. 401 root cause still unclear — need auth token logs + JWKS verification traces.

jamal_security: For the questionnaire we can assemble this package: - rotation_history.csv (ks: key-id, prev-version, rotated_at, change_request) - audit_export_sample.csv (redacted PII) - kms_key_metadata.json (algorithm, kms_key_id, policy snippet) - hsm_attestation.pdf (if available)

maria_cs: Priya/Jamal, can you each drop the exact command to extract the pieces so I can attach them? I'll scrub PII and timestamp to customer's TZ.

priya_sre: Commands:
```
# pull application traces for trace id
aws xray batch-get-traces --trace-ids trace-0ac1
# export audit logs for time window
pg_dump --data-only --table=audit_logs --where "event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-14T18:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-14T18:10:00Z'" > audit_slice.csv
# KMS key metadata
gcloud kms keys describe key-id --location=global --format=json > kms_key_metadata.json
```

jamal_security: For rotation history we keep an internal log; export:```
SELECT key_id, previous_key_version, rotated_at, requester, change_id FROM kms_rotation_log WHERE key_id='finra-kms-01' AND rotated_at > '2025-01-01' ORDER BY rotated_at DESC;
```I'll redact requester emails before handing off.

kevin_support: I'm drafting the extension email now. Suggest wording: "We are compiling your requested attestation and a redacted audit sample. Could you grant a 48-hour extension to accept these artifacts?" Want me to send on your behalf, @maria_cs?

maria_cs: Yes please. Use our standard extension wording and include INC-2026-318-KMS-EXPORT-401. Ask them whether they need a signed PDF or an S3 link.

Tom_Finra: 48 hours works. We need signed PDF preferred. Also confirm that redaction will not remove change ids.

jamal_security: Noted — we'll preserve change IDs and redact only user PII. I'll compile the attestation and policy excerpt and upload to secure S3 with MFA-protected link.

priya_sre: Action items: 1) I'll pull the trace and audit slice and upload to secure bucket (pr-3054/audit-finra). 2) Jamal will export rotation_history.csv and kms_key_metadata.json. 3) Maria/Keven will send extension request and attach timeline. ETA EOD PT.

kevin_support: Sent extension email to FinraCorp at 2026-03-15T09:10Z — they confirmed. Template attached: https://internal.redwood.example/docs/extensions/template-attach.txt

maria_cs: thanks all. I'll assemble package, scrub, and send signed PDF to Finra contact once Jamal uploads attestation. :thumbsup:

Tom_Finra: Appreciate it. We'll watch for the link.

maria_cs: Closing thread for now — will reopen if additional issues.
